Int.Set.claim: Copies the exact signed integer into the receiver and returns the receiver.
Int.Set.limits: Nonnil operands and destination with normalized magnitude. Lean models values. Native compares the returned receiver and unchanged distinct operands, with receiver aliasing, operands sharing one object and all pointers sharing one object when applicable. Nil pointers, direct raw-limb mutation, physical backing array identity and allocator behavior are outside scope.
Int.Set.configurations: Pinned Go direct method calls, compiled Lean and a separate exact signed decimal digit oracle. 240 fixed pairs with up to 721 decimal digits and 60,000 sampled pairs with up to 65 digits using seeds 17, 2718 and 65537. Native compares each pair separately, with destination equal to the first operand, and for binary operations with destination equal to the second operand.

Int.Quo.claim: Sets and returns the receiver to the quotient truncated toward zero. A zero divisor panics.
Int.Quo.limits: Normalized nonnil signed integers. Lean models exact values and division by zero. Native checks the exact panic text and unchanged state on a zero divisor, distinct primary receiver or primary receiver aliasing either operand. Dual-output calls use a remainder destination distinct from both operands and the quotient. Raw limb aliases, allocation and internal long-division algorithms are outside scope.
Int.Quo.configurations: Direct pinned Go calls, compiled Lean and an independent bitwise long-division oracle. 210 fixed operand pairs with up to 160 decimal digits and 60,000 sampled pairs using seeds 17, 2718 and 65537, each with applicable primary receiver profiles and representative shared operands.

Int.And.claim: Returns the bitwise intersection of unbounded two’s-complement integers.
Int.And.limits: Normalized nonnil signed magnitudes. Lean abstracts raw limbs and allocations. Native checks returned receiver identity on writes and distinct inputs, including destination aliasing either operand and shared inputs. Resource-exhausting shifts or indices are outside scope.
Int.And.configurations: Pinned Go and compiled Lean against a separate finite two’s-complement byte oracle with explicit sign extension. 3,584 fixed tuples and 60,000 sampled tuples at seeds 17, 2718 and 65537. Cases span signed values through 301 decimal digits, 0–511 shift counts, signed indices from -10 through 529, and both valid and invalid bit values.
